observations: Photo 0 shows a set of cleaning brushes: a tall bottle brush with green and orange handle, a white brush with a wide bristle head, a small green brush with a flexible neck, and a green brush with a flat head. There are also four circular insets showing stains: tea, cream, coffee, and oil.
Photo 1 shows four close-up uses: a green brush cleaning a glass lid, an orange brush cleaning a baby bottle nipple, a green brush cleaning inside a glass bottle, and a yellow brush cleaning a straw.
Photo 2 shows two long-handled brushes with orange and gray bristles, hanging on green suction cup holders on a wall. The handles are white with orange and gray accents.
All photos have a watermark: 'POSTED ON JIJI SKILLCITY ENTREPRENEUR'.

proof_requests: Photo of the full set laid out together to confirm all pieces are included.
Close-up of the bristles and handles to check material quality.

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a bottle and straw cleaning brush set, and the seller's claims about included brushes are supported by the photos. Hidden risks exist regarding material quality and suction cup performance, but these do not prevent pricing. The item can be priced at its worst case (low durability, possibly incomplete) until further proof is provided.
